environment.network: enabled only for read-only Sourceright clone and dependency retrieval; no live provider request was executed

checks.command: cargo test -p evidence-search-core -p searchright-sourceright-compat -p searchright-contracts -p searchright-connectors --all-features --locked
cargo clippy -p evidence-search-core -p searchright-contracts -p searchright-sourceright-compat -p searchright-connectors --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings

cargo test -p searchright-contracts -p searchright-sourceright-compat --all-features --locked && cargo clippy -p searchright-contracts -p searchright-sourceright-compat --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo check --locked

security_evidence.resolved_answer_policy: empty answers and any complete answer containing a prohibited IPv4 or IPv6 address fail closed
security_evidence.transport_binding: each live request resolves its approved hostname, validates the complete deduplicated answer and pins that socket set into a no-proxy, redirect-disabled HTTPS-only client
deterministic_cases: mixed public and private DNS answer rejected
complete public DNS answer accepted for pinning
0/8, deprecated IPv6 site-local and NAT64 translation ranges rejected
response chunks rejected before the accumulated buffer exceeds policy
cutover readiness rejects blank, duplicate, invented or incomplete parity case and dimension coverage

downstream_evidence.inventory_drift: provider runtime files unchanged from the original pinned inventory

claim_boundary: Compiler-backed Searchright runtime and compatibility evidence plus a clean read-only Sourceright baseline; no live provider, downstream integration, dual-run parity, SemVer, cutover, rollback, release or remote mutation claim.
